conviction_note: Almost everything I found on this print already has a broker note attached (UBS on a $1.25 FY EPS cut, KeyBanc on soft US through Q2, Piper on China softness and 'new competition on Tmall'), so I am claiming only a ~30%-of-implied directional residual: two China-side facts that post-date the 4 June guidance vintage and are covered in Asia trade press rather than US sell-side, netted against one small unaggregated positive (Wilson contractually silenced), against a chain that is leaning the other way with calls bid 27.8 vol points over puts.

findings.finding: lululemon's Q2 and FY26 guidance was set on 4 June 2026 and the release states it rests on 'management's expectations as of the date of this press release' - but the Great Wall drum crisis only went viral 11-13 days later (>50m Weibo views by 15 June, company apology 16-17 June), i.e. with roughly 7 of Q2's 13 weeks still to run, in the single segment (China Mainland, +30% revenue / +20% comp in Q1) that carries the entire growth story.
findings.why_not_priced: Every preview I read anchors comfort on 'consensus $1.79 sits inside the guided $1.76-1.81', which is only reassuring if the guide contains the quarter's events - and it demonstrably cannot, because the company's own guidance-vintage language dates it to 4 June and the crisis broke on ~15 June. If the market had marked the China line to the event you would see the 25-delta skew positive (downside bid) rather than the measured -27.82 with calls paid, and you would not see the stock up 3.38% over the five sessions into the print; instead the incident was written up as reputational/lifestyle news (CNN, Global Times, Forbes) and never converted into a segment revision.
findings.independence: Independent third-party series pointing the same way: Meritco Services data reported by SCMP shows lululemon same-store sales at sampled Chinese shopping malls down 4% y/y in May 2026, down 3% in April and down 6% in Q1 - https://www.scmp.com/business/article/3360991/fierce-competition-and-shifting-tastes-squeeze-chinas-yoga-apparel-market (2026-07-18). Note this shares only the China theme, not a source or a number, with the Alo finding below; the guidance-vintage document is https://corporate.lululemon.com/newsroom/press-releases/2026/06-04-2026-210523775.

findings.finding: Alo Yoga opened its Tmall flagship on 12 August 2026 and did RMB 10m (~$1.4m) of sales in the first minute - a record opening day for a new brand in Tmall's sports and outdoor category - after entering mainland China in June 2026 via WeChat and Xiaohongshu with K-pop star Ningning as ambassador.
findings.why_not_priced: This lands in Q3, not Q2, so it cannot show up in the printed numbers - it shows up only in the China commentary and the Q3/FY guide, which is exactly where the residual bull case for this stock lives. One broker (Piper Sandler) gestures at 'the arrival of new competition on Tmall' qualitatively in the 3 September preview, but the magnitude sits in Asia trade press and Chinese state media, not in US sell-side models; if it had been marked, the sell-side China growth assumption for H2 would have been cut publicly and the calls-bid skew would not be intact.
findings.independence: Chinese state media confirms the scale and the strategic framing from a different desk: https://www.globaltimes.cn/page/202608/1368079.shtml (August 2026, date in URL path). Thematically related to the drum finding above but a different mechanism (competitive entry in Q3 vs brand damage inside Q2), different sources, and no shared number.

findings.finding: Chip Wilson, an 8.7% holder who spent 2025-2026 publicly attacking the board and running a proxy fight, has been bound since 26 May 2026 by an ~18-month standstill and non-disparagement covenant running to 30 days before the 2028 nomination deadline - so this is the first LULU earnings print in over two years at which he cannot amplify a bad number the next morning.
findings.why_not_priced: Zero of the earnings previews I read mention the standstill; the cooperation agreement was covered on 27 May purely as a governance/proxy-war story and then dropped. It is a change in the day-after information environment rather than a change in the numbers, which is precisely the category no preview is written to cover - if it were priced, someone would have named the removal of the founder's post-print megaphone as a reason the left tail is thinner, and the day-two drift after the last three prints would not have been repeatedly extended by his public statements.
findings.independence: Terms independently reported with the 18-month duration and the 8.7% stake: https://stocktwits.com/news-articles/markets/equity/lululemon-agreement-with-chip-wilson-18-month-standstill/cZggJmoReAw. Both readings rest on the same 8-K, so treat the Oct-1-2026 apparel-expertise director appointment (also in that document, subject to Wilson's approval) as part of this one finding and not a second one.

Direct observation of 'We Made Too Much' item count and discount depth - shop.lululemon.com returned 503, and every search result for August 2026 markdown depth was coupon-affiliate content with no measurable series

Chineseconsumers.news #76 on lululemon's China events flopping (2026-06-19), which references TWO controversial China events rather than one - paywalled, could not verify the second
Zhu Yilong brand-ambassador status: no evidence the relationship ended; the 2026-08-17 'first global ambassador' signing is a fragrance brand (Documents), not an athleisure competitor - dead end
China store closures or a cut to the ~170-to-220 mainland store plan - nothing found
New buyback authorisation or accelerated repurchase in 2026 - nothing beyond the December 2025 $1bn increase
Reddit/app-store sentiment on the Fall 2026 Fast and Free relaunch - only brand PR coverage, no measurable review-volume or rating series
baseline_tension: My residual cuts squarely against the baseline: the chain is paying 27.8 vol points more for calls than puts and the stock is up 3.38% over five sessions, i.e. the market is positioned for relief on a name 45% off its high at ~10.7x guided EPS with 8.67% short interest, whereas my two China facts both post-date the 4 June guidance vintage and point down - but I keep the number to a third of the 9.42% implied because the low implied move is defensible rather than wrong (Q2 EPS is pre-guided to a $0.05 band with consensus dead-centre, the incoming CEO's effective date is 8 September so she is not on this call and no genuine kitchen-sink reset or strategy reveal is available to interim co-CEOs, and the last two reactions -8.56% and +3.84% are the two smallest of the seven as the multiple has compressed).
